**n001se**: FM percussion and an acid line with a random sequencer, for the M-VAVE FM-1.

> Custom firmware is installed at your own risk: have M-VAVE's stock firmware (FM-1 V15, "PC Firmware"
> at m-vave.com/download) ready first. The platform (update loader, safe mode) is FiMba-1's, unchanged.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `n001se-VERSION.fwsc` | The firmware package, to install on the FM-1 |

Install it with M-VAVE's **M-UPGRADE** tool, or from <https://jadamsowers.github.io/fm1-fimba/#install>
("Or a firmware file"), or with `python3 tools/fm1_install.py n001se-VERSION.fwsc`.
The manual (Swedish) is [docs/MANUAL.txt](https://github.com/Saintpid/n001se/blob/main/docs/MANUAL.txt).
